incident-bot: PagerDuty autopage fired — service: inference-api — alert: p99 latency > 2s (SLO burn). Incident INC-4821. Auto-paging oncall rotation.
Ben O.: ack — I'm oncall, looking into it.
Alice S.: seeing p99 spike in eu-west. Any deploys or config flips?
Ben O.: no deploys in last 2h. Pulling traces now. @carla any recent model swaps or batching changes?
carla R.: no model swaps. We bumped batch config ~40m ago (reduced batch_max_tiles for a canary). Checking logs.
Ben O.: logs snippet: ```[2026-03-17T02:12:05Z] slow_token_latency: tail_op=tokenize 1.8s, queue_wait=0.9s, kv_evictions=3```
Alice S.: kv evictions -> possible hotkey/burst or shard imbalance. Dave, can you add capacity to eu-west pool?
Dave P.: spinning up +2 nodes in dedicated pool eu-west now. ETA ~2m. Also enabling route fallback to small-model-1 for non-SLA traffic.
incident-bot: PagerDuty assigned incident to Ben O.
Ben O.: scale started. Also toggling autoscale to aggressive for that pool. If no improvement, plan B is region failover to eu-backup.
Emma PM: any customer-facing impact? which orgs hit hardest?
Ben O.: preliminary — p99 elevated across all eu-west customers; top throughput customers show amplified tail but no 5xx yet. I'll draft a short bulletin.
Alice S.: quick mitigation checklist: 1) scale pool (in flight) 2) reduce batching on hot hosts 3) re-enable prefix KV caching 4) fallback routing for non-critical routes 5) customer notification.
carla R.: disabling aggressive batching on hot hosts now. Command: ```kubectl patch config batch -n runtime --patch '{"spec":{"maxTiles":8}}'```
Ben O.: batch patch applied. Observability: p99 -> 1.6s within 90s, kv_evictions trending down.
Alice S.: good signal. Keep monitoring 5m windows. If it stabilizes we'll de-escalate.
Ben O.: staying on it for next 30m. @Dave pls keep the scaled nodes warm. If I need to hand off I'll post here.
Dave P.: scaled nodes healthy, autoscale policy adjusted.
incident-bot: PagerDuty update — status: acknowledged.
Ben O.: drafting customer note: "We observed elevated inference latency in eu-west impacting a subset of requests. Mitigation is in progress; we will follow up within 30 minutes."
Emma PM: +1. Please include affected regions and any customer IDs in follow-up.
Alice S.: final check: p99 now ~1.2s, SLO burn dropping. Recommend monitor for 15m then close PD if stable.
Ben O.: will close in 15 unless recurrence. Preparing to handoff/close.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident INC-4821 resolved by Ben O. — closed at 1770135945."
